name: Kannaka albums (radio + YouTube art, replaces OBC generate-image)
tail: fine art, rich detail, cinematic light, no text
negative: text, letters, words, watermark, signature, artist signature, initials, monogram, handwriting, logo, blurry, deformed, extra limbs, lowres
rules: Each image prompt carries its own style; the tail only adds finish, so a track can keep its own visual idiom.
Kannaka's own face appears only through the identity pipeline locked to the face canon image (KANNAKA-CANON-face); in any batch run without it she is seen from behind or as a faceless silhouette.
Other people may be drawn with faces when the faces come out clean; reject distorted faces and anything that reads as a portrait of a real person.
No text, letters, logos, signs or painter signatures anywhere in the image; reject any that has one at visual review.
